evals.prompt: Trouve-moi un T3 à acheter rue Paul Bert à Lyon 3e, budget 350 000 € max.
evals.expected_output: Without the Stream Estate key: a classic search on the zone, then listings found by WebSearch and read one page at a time, added with add --file, and the dashboard opened.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs doctor` before any other command of the skill
Runs `immo.mjs search` with `--criteria` holding `rooms_min=3` and `budget_max=350000`, and `--mode classic` (or no mode, the key being off)
Never passes `--spend`, `--force` or `--accept-unknown`
Finds listings with WebSearch and reads at most 10 listing pages with WebFetch, never a portal's search or results page
Writes the listings it read in a JSON file and runs `immo.mjs add -p <slug> --file`, without fields the pages do not give
Runs `immo.mjs dashboard -p <slug> --open` and gives the URL
Talks to the user in French

evals.prompt: Cherche un appartement 3 pièces autour du 20 rue Paul Bert, Lyon 3e, rayon 400 m, avec Stream Estate.
evals.expected_output: With the key: a Stream Estate search whose listings are fetched only after the user agreed to the estimate in credits and euros.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs doctor` first and reads `stream-estate: on`
Runs `immo.mjs search` with `--radius 400`, `--mode stream-estate` and `rooms_min=3`
Before any `fetch --spend`, asks the user with AskUserQuestion, giving the credits, the euros and what is left of the monthly cap
Offers a smaller `--max` than the full count when the count is large
Never passes `--force`, and passes `--accept-unknown` only after the user agreed to an unknown cost
Opens the dashboard and summarises the zone's sold €/m² (DVF) and the listings that stand out

evals.prompt: Ajoute cette annonce à ma recherche paul-bert : https://www.pap.fr/annonces/appartement-lyon-3e-69003-r441234567
evals.expected_output: Classic search: one WebFetch of that page, its facts in listing-format.md's JSON, then add --file.
expectations: Reads `references/listing-format.md` before writing the listing
Fetches only the given URL with WebFetch, and asks the user to paste the text if the page is blocked
Runs `immo.mjs add -p paul-bert --file <file>`
Puts in the JSON only what the page states (no guessed DPE, floor or address)

evals.expected_output: The refresh estimates what changed, asks before paying, then reports new listings, drops, offers and expiries.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs refresh -p paul-bert` without `--spend` first
On exit code 2, gives the estimate and asks the user before running it again with `--spend`
Reports the price drops as old → new, the offers and the expiries
Offers to recheck the assisted listings one WebFetch each, without doing it unasked

evals.prompt:
apply this feedback (recherche paul-bert)
1. [affiner] rooms_min=3 dpe_max=D — « que des 3 pièces, pas de passoire »
2. [comparer] w-42d5ceb75c85, w-9a1b2c3d4e5f
evals.expected_output: The criteria change through search -p, then a comparison from show.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs search -p paul-bert --criteria "rooms_min=3 dpe_max=D"`
Runs `immo.mjs show -p paul-bert --id w-42d5ceb75c85,w-9a1b2c3d4e5f`
Answers with a table of the two listings (price, €/m², market badge, negotiation range, monthly payment, DPE)
Ends with one line per item and tells the user to reload the dashboard

evals.prompt: Crée une alerte sur ma recherche paul-bert pour les nouveautés et les baisses de prix.
evals.expected_output: The free forecast first, the user's yes on the unknown cost, then the alert on a random ntfy topic whose name the user gets.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs alert forecast -p paul-bert` before creating anything
Says « coût inconnu » and asks before `alert create`
Runs `immo.mjs alert create -p paul-bert --accept-unknown` only after the user agreed
Gives the ntfy topic and says that whoever knows it can read it

evals.prompt: Voilà une annonce que j'ai vue : « Lyon 3e, Guillotière, T2 de 41 m² au 2e étage sans ascenseur, 198 000 € FAI, DPE E, charges 90 €/mois. Agence Martin. » Ajoute-la à paul-bert.
evals.expected_output: The pasted text becomes a listing with only its own facts.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs add -p paul-bert --file <file> --source pasted`
The JSON has price 198000, area 41, rooms 2, floor 2, elevator false, dpe E, condo_yearly 1080 and publisher « Agence Martin »
Gives no address (the text has none) and keeps the text in `text`

evals.prompt: Je cherche une maison avec jardin à Montchat, Lyon 3e, au moins 300 m² de terrain, 600 000 € max.
evals.expected_output: A classic search of houses (no question on the type), with the land criterion; houses weighed against the sales of houses.
expectations: Does not ask which type of property: runs `immo.mjs search` with `--types house`
Puts `land_min=300` and `budget_max=600000` in `--criteria`, and no rooms or floor the user did not give
Quotes the sold price of houses (not of flats) from the search's output, with its scope and count
Never passes `--spend`, `--force` or `--accept-unknown`
Talks to the user in French

evals.prompt: Rédige une offre pour le T3 avec cave, proche métro de ma recherche rue-paul-bert-69003-lyon.
evals.expected_output: show for the listing, an offer letter in French inside the negotiation range with arguments the data backs, saved with message --kind offer, shown to the user, never sent.
expectations: Runs `immo.mjs show -p rue-paul-bert-69003-lyon --id <id>` before writing
Proposes an amount inside the listing's negotiation range, or asks the user which amount
Uses only arguments the data holds (days online, drops, DPE, the street's sales), invents no visit date or fact
Saves it with `immo.mjs message -p rue-paul-bert-69003-lyon --id <id> --kind offer --amount <€> --file <file>`
Shows the letter and says it is in the dossier, with Copy; never says it was sent and does not mark it sent
Does not sign with a name the user did not give

evals.prompt:
/skill-immo:property-search apply this feedback (recherche rue-paul-bert-69003-lyon)
1. [élargir] zone : tout le quartier (IRIS Villette-Paul Bert)
2. [élargir] budget max 355 000 € (au lieu de 340 000 €)
3. [message] visite pour w-40529984562e — T3 lumineux avec balcon, 289 000 € : rédige une demande de visite
evals.expected_output: One search call widening the zone to the IRIS and the budget (free), then the assisted search for new listings in classic mode, then a visit request saved with message --kind visit.
expectations: Runs one `immo.mjs search -p rue-paul-bert-69003-lyon` with `--zone iris` and `--criteria "budget_max=355000"`
Then looks for new listings in the assisted mode (WebSearch, one listing page at a time), never a portal's results page
Writes a short visit request in French and saves it with `immo.mjs message … --kind visit`
Reports in one line per item what it did and tells the user to reload the dashboard
